name: OnLastWindowClose
purpose: Last-window-close trigger: clears Picker::Results, Search_Field and Settings; if the file is opened locally, shows the splash layout, hides toolbars and ruler, sets zoom 100 and restores window size/position.
writes:
Picker::Results#2 (Set Field step 2, global)
Picker::Search_Field#1 (Set Field step 3, global)
Picker::Settings#4 (Set Field step 4, global)
open_question: Picker::Results, Search_Field and Settings are global fields. Local-open housecleaning only runs when Get(MultiUserState) <> 2.

name: Handle Keystroke on Picker Row
purpose: Keystroke handler for a picker result row: arrows/tab move to the previous/next record or to the search field/execute button; space selects the party (script 71); enter/return either confirms adding the selected contacts (with a count dialog when multiple selection is on) via 'Close Picker' (94) or selects the party; returns False to swallow handled keys.
open_question: Behaviour depends on Picker::Settings_AllowMultipleSelectionsInd#6 and the JSON in Picker::Results ('Result.CountPicked'). The enter/return confirmation prompt exists to avoid accidental adds.
